Container.Name: KitCatalogue
Container.Overview: Self-hosted Building Kits & Scale Model Catalogue for Gundam/Gunpla, Moshow, Book Nooks, and scale models. Features Owned vs. Wishlist tracking, build statuses, stance photo galleries, PDF manual viewer, and multi-user management where the first user becomes Admin.

Config.Name: AppData Storage (/data)
Config.Description: Persistent storage for SQLite database, stance photos, and PDF manuals
